name: COSMOS for Centauri Carbon 1
description: Printer profiles required to use [OpenCentauri COSMOS](https://github.com/OpenCentauri/cosmos) for the CC1.

content.name: Elegoo Centauri Carbon 0.2 nozzle - Cosmos
content.machine_start_gcode:
M104 S0 ; Stops OrcaSlicer from sending temp waits separately

M140 S0

SET_PRINT_STATS_INFO TOTAL_LAYER=[total_layer_count]

PRINT_START EXTRUDER=[first_layer_temperature] BED=[first_layer_bed_temperature] CHAMBER=[chamber_temperature]
